title: Uth raha hai janaaza raza ka
body:
SHOR HAI YEH QURAASA'N MEIN BARPA.
MAR GAYE HAAYE GHURBAT MEIN MOULA.
UTH RAHA HAIN JANAZA RAZA ASWS. KA.
1. YA NAHI HAI HAZEEN RONE WAALE.
HAAYE YASRAB MEIN HAIN RONE WAALE.
KISKO DE SHAAH E WAALA KA PURSA-- UTH RAHA HAIN JANAZA RAZA ASWS. KA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. GHAR KO JAANE KI PAAYI NA MOHLAT.
ZEHER SE MARGAYE HAAYE HAZRAT.
AAO SYED KO DE CHALKE KAANDHA-- UTH RAHA HAIN JANAZA RAZA ASWS. KA.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. SHAAH E WAALA KI KARLU'N ZIYARAT.
AAQRI HAI YEH DEEDARE HUJJAT.
AB NAZAR AAYENGE PHIR NA MOULA-- UTH RAHA HAIN JANAZA RAZA ASWS. KA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. MUNTAZIR HOGI BEKAS BEHEN HAAY.
YAAD MEIN HONGE AHLE WATAN HAAY.
KYA QABAR UNKO HOGI KE IS JAA-- UTH RAHA HAIN JANAZA RAZA ASWS. KA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SHEHER KE LOG SAB RO RAHE THE.
TAZKIRA SHAAH KA HO RAHA THA.
AY RIYAAZAT QURAASA'N MEIN GHUL THA-- UTH RAHA HAIN JANAZA RAZA ASWS. KA.
Kalaam: JANAB RIYAAZAT SAHAB.
